defect: rebasing the Substrate branch onto the sealed temporal terminal head rewrote every Substrate commit hash. Every sealed Substrate artifact still carried its pre rebase source_commit, which is no longer an ancestor of HEAD, so thirty eight of forty one items silently lost their evidence and dropped from measured or terminal back to tested
correction: no code change was needed. The guard added by C_EVIDENCE_PRESENCE already refuses an artifact whose commit is unreachable from HEAD, and it fired on a situation it was not written for. The repair is operational: after any history rewrite the whole seal chain is regenerated at the new head and the independent recomputation is rerun. This correction records that a rebase is a reseal event
reproduced_by: observed directly after rebasing twelve Substrate commits onto 0a549ef; state reported tested 38, terminal 3 until every artifact was resealed
rule: a reproduced defect overrides reviewer votes and becomes a permanent regression test
